Triage first-touch — concentrated round #2 (triage seat, session `session_019ZyCHcjXeTFPiS8RWRk4nN`, 2026-08-19): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` · Task. A pin whose expected value is a sort artifact judges the wrong thing in both directions the moment the repo splits (measured: it went red blaming the template for a 21-vs-1 split it was not party to). Dispatch route, in the card's own preference order: put the `lucide-react` line behind the same in-repo-consistency precondition the `@object-ui/*` anchor rule uses (assert `toHaveLength(1)` before referencing the single range, or reuse the anchor rule's computed expectation); **deleting the line instead is acceptable only after verifying** the same-file byte-for-byte manifest assertion actually covers the written manifest's `lucide-react` entry — verify, then choose, and say which in the PR. Size/model suggestion: S-mechanical, sonnet.

Claim: PM loop round 9
Session: `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe` · Branch: `claude/issue-4991-lucide-pin-range-consistency` · Worktree: `objectui-issue-4991`
Domain: `domain:devx` (@ objectui, seat #5748) · Container & model: S, `mode:subagent`, `model: sonnet` · Clause-②: no
File surface: `packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts`
Serial constraints cleared: in-flight 0. Disjoint from open PRs #5988 / #5989 / #5991 / #5995 and co-dispatched #5754, #4938, #4964, #4996.

## PM-verified premise on `origin/main` @ `53dc89db8`

`inRepoRangesOf` is defined at **`packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts:292`** and read at **`:588`**, **`:652`** (`Object.keys(inRepoRangesOf(name))[0]`) and **`:672`**. The card's complaint is that the pin takes **an arbitrary member** of the in-repo ranges — the first key / `.sort()[0]` — and asserts against it, **without asserting the ranges are consistent in the first place**.

⚠️ So when the repo's declarations for a package **split** across two ranges, the pin quietly picks one and can validate against the **minority** spelling, reporting green while the repo is internally inconsistent. The pin's own subject — "the repo agrees on this dependency's range" — is the thing it never checks.

## Zone 2 — measure first

- ⛔ **Is the split live or hypothetical today?** Enumerate `inRepoRangesOf('lucide-react')` (and the other pinned names read at those sites) on current `main` and report **how many distinct ranges each has**. If every one has exactly 1, this is **latent** — say so plainly, ⛔ do not imply you fixed a live wrong-green, and ⛔ do not manufacture a split to justify the change.
- ⚠️ **Adding the consistency assertion may turn the file red immediately** if some package genuinely has a split today. That is a real possible outcome and a good one — but then **stop and report the split** rather than picking a winner: choosing which range is canonical is a dependency decision, ⛔ not a test fix.
- Note `:652` uses `Object.keys(...)[0]` and the card cites `.sort()[0]` — **check whether both spellings exist**; a fix that hardens one and leaves the other is the half-fix this lane has hit twice today (#5007's two citation sites, #4902's two directions).

## Rulings (⛔ not re-adjudicable)

- ⛔ Scope: the consistency assertion in this test file. Changing any package's declared range is **out of scope** — report it.
- The assertion must **name the package and all its competing ranges** when it fails. A bare "ranges differ" reproduces the diagnosis problem one level up.

## Gates

Derive from your diff. At minimum `packages/cli`'s own test run and `type-check`, plus Lint. Run `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and follow its verdict — ⚠️ `packages/cli` **is** a released package, so a `src/` change may owe a changeset even though this is a test file; let the gate decide rather than assuming. ⛔ No `skip-changeset` label (#4912/#3724).

⚠️ Restore idiom (objectstack#11648): `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`, prove with `git diff HEAD`.

Draft PR, `Fixes #4991`, report as an issue comment with the `<!-- os-dev-report -->` marker (⚠️ sanitizer strips it — read back, repost as literal text). Report the per-package range counts you measured and whether the defect is live or latent.

## ACCEPT — PR #6021. Landing on CI convergence.

Reviewer of record: `domain:devx` @ objectui seat (#5748), round **R9**, PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`.

### Both spellings fixed — the half-fix I warned about did not happen

The dispatch flagged that `:652` used `Object.keys(...)[0]` while the card cited `.sort()[0]`, and that hardening one and leaving the other is the failure this lane hit twice today (#5007's two citation sites, #4902's two directions). **Both were routed through the new `soleInRepoRangeOf(name)` helper**, and the anchor-table loop — which already had the precondition inline — was refactored to call it rather than keep a third copy. One assertion, three call sites, ⛔ no duplicated invariant left to drift.

### ⚠️ The reverse verification found something better than "the assertion fires"

It mutated `packages/plugin-tree/package.json` to create a **real 22-vs-1 split**, confirmed the mutation on disk, and compared diagnoses:

| | what the failure said |
|:--|:--|
| **old code** | blamed the **template** — *expected `'^1.31.0'` to be `'^1.30.0'`* |
| **new code** | `in-repo manifests disagree on lucide-react: {"^1.31.0":[…22 manifests],"^1.30.0":["packages/plugin-tree/package.json"]} — settle on one range first` |

⚠️ So the old pin did not merely **miss** a split — it **actively misdiagnosed** it, pointing the reader at the generator template when the defect was a single package manifest. That is worse than a silent gap and is the real value of this card; the issue had documented that wrong diagnosis and it is now measured.

Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- <path>` (the objectstack#11648 safe spelling), proved with an empty `git diff HEAD`, 41/41 green again.

### Latent, stated plainly

`lucide-react`, `@tailwindcss/postcss`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`, `postcss` — **1 declared range each** on `main` @ `53dc89db8`. ⛔ No live wrong-green existed, and the report says so rather than implying one was fixed. ⛔ No split was manufactured to justify the work; the one created for ablation was restored and proved gone.

### Scope held

⛔ No package's declared range was changed — exactly as ruled. Empty-frontmatter changeset added **per the gate's own instruction**, not by assumption.

### Landing

`packages/cli/src/__tests__/**` and `.changeset/**` are **not** governed surface. Maintainer's ruling, 2026-08-24, verbatim: 「授权 auto-merge（推荐）」 — every check green, ⛔ not the `required` subset.
